correctness.rationale: For each fixed k>=2 and only the z0=1 translation-invariant boundary-law branch, source folds solve x²+[2-(b-1)(k-1)]x+b=0. Coalescence b0=((k+1)/(k-1))² and x_c=(k+1)/(k-1) gives a_c=x_c^-(k+1), hence lambda_c=2[(k+1)/sqrt(k²+6k+1)]^(k+1). The mixed/cubic derivatives F_xb=(k-1)^4/[4k(k+1)²] and F_xxx=-(k-1)^4/[2k²(k+1)²], and discriminant D=4kε+O(ε²) yield a log-fold gap proportional to ε^(3/2); epsilon=b-b0=theta_c^-3(theta_c-theta)+O((theta_c-theta)²). This proves exact K_k=lambda_c(k²+6k+1)^(9/4)/[3(k+1)² sqrt(k(k-1))] and O((theta_c-theta)^(5/2)) remainder. Independently high-precision evaluated k=2,3,6 near critical, ratios near 1; no claims outside branch or uniform k.
